new_findings.subject: Beta 208984, Area C:East layer 3a fire pit
new_findings.assertion: Sload reports Beta 208984 1920 ± 60 BP, calibrated 1σ 30–130 CE, 2σ 40 BCE–230 CE, from an apparent fire pit by Rock 1 on early fill. She interprets charcoal as early Use, not direct Sun Pyramid construction dating.
new_findings.exact_locator: Sload 2020 printed p.67, Table 5.3 and associated discussion
new_findings.limitation: Firing episode and its timing need not coincide with initial cave excavation.

new_findings.subject: Projected profile geometry of Beta 220753
new_findings.assertion: Beta 220753 (C:East layer 4d fire pit, 1810 ± 40 BP, 2σ 110–330 CE) lies farther south of Figure 5.1's projected cross-section. Author notes pit oriented roughly 90 degrees to section; drawing cannot establish direct superposition between Beta 220754 and 208984.
new_findings.limitation: Independent inspection of Altschul 1978a field profile remains pending.

new_findings.subject: Phase-assignment sensitivity of cave closure model
new_findings.assertion: Sload reran an OxCal overlapping-phase model with Beta 220760 and 220745 moved from Termination to Use. Modeled excavation onset barely changed; Use extended later, while Termination posterior had a second near-mid-fourth-century mode nearly as strong as mid-third-century one.
new_findings.limitation: This is author-reported model sensitivity, not independently recomputed and not proof of fourth-century closure.

new_findings.subject: Individual model agreement issue for Beta 266130
new_findings.assertion: The most recent cave charcoal sample Beta 266130 from C:West layer 5h below Blockage 12 yielded 1700 ± 40 BP (2σ 240–420 CE); Sload reports an individual agreement index of 57.7, below the discussed 60% threshold.
new_findings.exact_locator: Sload 2020 printed pp.66–67 Tables 5.2–5.3, and p.71 discussion
new_findings.limitation: A low individual agreement index flags model fit; it cannot alone invalidate laboratory age.
